headline: Lesotho Dam Agency Carries $8.5 Million in Compensation Arrears
summary: Lesotho's dam agency accumulated $8.5 million in compensation arrears at the end of 2025 as its water treaty with South Africa marked its 40th anniversary.
why: Water resource treaties and associated infrastructure project liabilities affect cross-border utility economics and government obligations.

impacts.name: Lesotho
impacts.why: Outstanding financial arrears highlight budgetary constraints within public utility agencies.
